# Code of Conduct

## Our commitment

As a community, we are committed to respectful, inclusive, and harassment-free
participation, regardless of experience, identity, background, appearance,
religion, or personal circumstances.

## Expected behavior

- Use welcoming and respectful language.
- Critique ideas and technical decisions, not people.
- Consider different perspectives and accept constructive feedback.
- Help keep discussions focused, accessible, and appropriate to their context.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, personal attacks, discrimination, intimidation, publishing
private information without consent, and deliberately disruptive conduct are
not acceptable in project spaces.

## Enforcement

Report inappropriate behavior to the maintainers through a private channel
listed on the repository profile. Include sufficient context for an
investigation, and avoid disclosing personal information publicly. Maintainers
will review each report and may remove content or restrict participation.

This Code of Conduct is inspired by Contributor Covenant, version 2.1:
<https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/>.
